items.summary: Add a backend function that allows the canister owner/admin to set and update the ICP payment address (ownerIcpAddress) used for payment gating. This function should be restricted to the canister owner and persist the address in stable storage.

Add an admin configuration panel or modal accessible from the PaymentGate screen (or a separate admin-only route) that allows the owner to view and update the ICP payment wallet address. The panel should display the current configured address and provide an input field plus save button to update it. Only show this UI when the authenticated user is the canister owner.
